threshold_comparison: Literal original control flow / initial per-bar percentiles versus conventional three-means, diagnostic only. Fixed identical load anchor per comparison.

channels_26nov: Derived transcript review only; exact time/price anchors and scale absent. No numeric floor-break signal inferred.
